LanguageData.LumenControl.AdjustGlowRadiusDesc: Change the glow radius of this light.
LanguageData.LumenControl.ScalePowerWithRadiusDesc: When enabled, lights that draw electricity consume extra power for every radius above their default glow radius. Shrinking a light below its default never reduces its power draw below normal.
LanguageData.LumenControl.PowerCostPercentPerRadius: Additional power per radius above default (%)
LanguageData.LumenControl.PowerCostPercentPerRadiusDe: The percentage of a light's normal power consumption added for each full radius its glow radius is increased above its default. Only applies while "Scale power consumption with radius" is enabled.
